parole.significato: sheepfold, pen (portable enclosure in the Western Carpathians, built of detachable bays)
parole.testo: Inherited from Old Polish koszara, from a Romance language (cf. Romanian coșar /coșara /cașare), from Old Church Slavonic кошара (košara), from Proto-Slavic *košàra.
